Formatly

Formatly

Convert documents, ebooks, email, spreadsheets, slides and images between formats. Files stay in your browser. Every route is checked first and flagged when layout may change.

on-device · no upload
Drop files here or click to choose PDF, DOCX, ODT, RTF, EPUB, EML, MSG, MBOX, XLSX/XLS/ODS/CSV, PPTX, DXF, HTML, Markdown, TXT, JSON, images (incl. TIFF/HEIC) and audio/video tracks. Several files at once is fine.
Size vs quality
Applies to PDF, JPG, WebP. Quality is lowered step by step until it fits.
Source page sizes in DOCX, PPTX and PDF are always kept.
Tokens: {name} {preset} {date} {n}. Example: {name}-{preset}
For Searchable PDF and Text via OCR. Needs internet once (standalone file).
